about_the_game:
Game Overview

This game offers a unique fusion of the satisfying physics-based action of Peggle with the strategic depth of a Roguelike. Players will launch pinballs with special abilities to hit pegs across the board and collect a wide variety of products. The core of the game lies in cleverly building synergies and chain reactions between these products, aided by unique staff members, to achieve astonishingly high scores. Every launch is a thrilling combination of skill, strategy, and a touch of luck.

Detailed Introduction & Core Features

- The Pure Fun of Physics-Based Pinball: Experience the sheer joy of watching your ball bounce and ricochet between pegs, triggering satisfying combos with a feast for the eyes and ears. Precise aiming is fundamental, but every collision, simulated by the physics engine, can lead to unexpected and delightful outcomes, making every shot exciting.

- Deep Strategic Deck-Building: The game is about much more than just hitting pegs. Every "product" you collect is crucial. Products not only have a base value but also belong to different "groups" (like Food, Animal, Tool, etc.) and have "tags" (like Fruit, Round, Metal, etc.). The real magic lies in the synergies between them: when specific conditions are met (e.g., having both an "Apple" and a "Pie" in your cart), the value of products can multiply. Discovering and exploiting these combinations is the key to high scores.

- Build Your Unique Scoring Engine:

- Massive Variety of Products: Hundreds of products are waiting to be collected, each with unique properties and potential synergies. You'll need to strategically select and collect them, much like building a deck of cards, to create your one-of-a-kind scoring engine.

- Quirky Staff Members: Between levels, you can hire staff members with diverse abilities in the shop. They provide powerful, game-altering passive buffs. Some might double the value of all "Fruit" products, others might reward you with extra balls for completing specific combos, and some might even add more high-value pegs to the board when you reroll.

- Specialized Pinballs: Unlock and choose from different types of pinballs. They not only possess unique physical properties (like higher bounce or heavier mass) but may also come with special abilities (like splitting into multiple balls or allowing a mid-air aim adjustment). The type of ball you choose also determines your collection slot limit per launch, adding another layer of strategic planning.

- Roguelike Progression & Endless Replayability: Every playthrough is a new challenge. You'll face randomly generated peg layouts, shop inventories, and level objectives. After successfully clearing a level, use your earnings to invest wisely in the shop—buy new products, hire new staff, and prepare for the tougher challenges ahead. The vast number of combinations between products, staff, and pinballs ensures that every game feels fresh and full of discovery. You'll always be finding new, powerful, and even surprisingly effective synergies.

short_description: This is a roguelite pinball game. You can choose products for the pegs, and you can also decide the ball’s trajectory. Earn higher scores to clear levels. Enjoy diverse build combinations between products. Hire power sources to enhance your strategy and maximize your income.
